verdict.rationale: MX documents that developers can download an OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman, and a dedicated GitHub repo (mxenabled/openapi) hosts the actual machine-readable spec for the MX Platform API. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the hosted spec stays current and is discoverable at a standard well-known endpoint (probe found no /openapi.json at expected paths, relying on docs/GitHub instead).
